instruction_covers: Pure rename(__data, **kwargs) exported from package; new-name -> old column via string or simple expression, single and multiple renames with row data preserved
Deterministic repeat calls, no input mutation, no filesystem/network/global-state side effects
Grouped pandas rename updates the group key (group_by(df, _.a) >> rename(z=_.a) grouped by z)
SQL lazy tables build a labeled select (column labeled A), preserve unrenamed columns, update lazy grouping keys
Invalid non-simple target raises ValueError on pandas and KeyError on SQL lazy tables
label: sound
notes: The fresh-subprocess-equality and no-open/no-socket tests are guardrails that any straightforward pure implementation of the stated behavior satisfies; they demand no additional feature.
